```sql
SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    u.Location
FROM main.users u
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ans.OwnerUserId,
        COUNT(*) as accepted_count
    FROM main.posts q
    JOIN main.posts ans ON q.AcceptedAnswerId = ans.Id
    WHERE q.PostTypeId = 1
      AND ans.PostTypeId = 2
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', ans.CreaionDate) = '2013-06-01'
    GROUP BY ans.OwnerUserId
    ORDER BY accepted_count DESC
    LIMIT 10
) top_users ON u.Id = top_users.OwnerUserId
```
